title: AI build chat (full page): the floating pending-drafts bar covers the composer's input line, so the placeholder and the first typed line are hidden
body:
Part of #12724. Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`), which dispatches #12724 on the maintainer's order (「objectui #12724 和 #12725 你也负责派发。」). Source: the #12965 dev report on PR #12975, out-of-scope finding 1 (class a, user-visible occlusion). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What was measured

- **Where:** the full-page AI build chat (`/ai/build?package=com.example.showcase`), with the real build agent and one pending draft, at 1280 × 900, zh-CN.
- **What the user sees:** `ChatPane`'s `PendingDraftsBar` (`packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`, the `absolute bottom-20` float) overlaps the composer's textarea by 670 × 51 px. All five first-line points of the input hit the bar, so the placeholder 「问问数据，或让我改改这个应用…」 and the first typed line are hidden.
- **Evidence:** branch `claude/issue-12965-evidence` at `df567c61`, `evidence/12965/before-fullpage-1280-draft-pending.png` and `before-fullpage-1280.json`. The reading is the same after PR #12975, which removes the bar only inside the package's Studio (#12965).
- **Not measured:** the console dock.

## Target

The full-page chat keeps its bar, because there is no Studio top bar there to carry 变更 and 发布. The bar never covers the composer. It sits in the layout above the composer (or the composer's area makes room for it), at every width the chat supports, and the same holds for the console dock if it draws the bar.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (where `ChatPane` mounts the bar), tests beside it, a changeset. ⛔ Not `PendingDraftsBar`'s own behaviour, and not `packages/plugin-chatbot/**` unless a prop it already declares is missing.

## Acceptance

1. A test: with a pending draft on the full-page chat, the bar's box and the composer's input do not intersect. The same for the console dock, if it draws the bar.
2. Screenshots at 1010 and 1280 px, with the placeholder visible whole and the bar visible.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` is green.

## Dedupe

300 objectui issues (open and closed, by last update) scanned for `PendingDraftsBar`, "pending drafts bar" and 尚未发布 with composer or 输入: the only hits are #12965 (the Studio copilot) and PR #12975.
